clips.title: The story
paras: Night Run is a small, secluded satyr outpost perched atop a cliff-ringed bluff in east-central Ashenvale. Inhabited by the demonic Felmusk satyr, it serves as a corrupted encampment harboring dark soul magic within ancient elven ruins.

Night Run is the smallest and most isolated of Ashenvale's three major satyr strongholds, alongside Xavian and Satyrnaar. Sheltered among crumbling elven stonework and broken pillars, the settlement juts outward on a high ridge bounded by steep, impassable cliffs. Reaching it requires a circuitous trek along the Falfarren River near the waters of Xavian or navigating a precarious northern ledge above Raynewood Retreat. Despite its modest size, the enclave poses a severe danger: the Felmusk satyr who dwell here work in concert with the shadowy Cult of the Dark Strand, anchoring twisted soulgems to pool demonic essence within the forest.
